anomalies.description: A black SUV enters the frame and collides with a yellow-and-black striped boom barrier that is in the down (closed) position, causing visible impact and deformation of the barrier; this constitutes a road accident involving vehicle collision with infrastructure.

original_descriptions.description: A black SUV enters the frame and collides with a yellow-and-black striped boom barrier that is in the down (closed) position, causing visible impact and deformation of the barrier; this constitutes a road accident involving vehicle collision with infrastructure.

A black SUV loses control, collides with a yellow-and-black striped pole, and flips onto its roof, resulting in a severe road accident with debris scattered and a person (in pink clothing) ejected or lying near the vehicle. A white car is also present nearby, and bystanders rush toward the scene.

A black vehicle is overturned on its roof in the middle of the road, with visible debris and a red cloth/object near it, indicating a recent road accident (collision or rollover). Multiple people are approaching or reacting to the scene, consistent with an emergency response to a crash. The white car nearby appears stationary but positioned close to the incident, suggesting possible involvement or proximity to the collision.

A black vehicle is overturned on its side on the road, indicating a recent crash or rollover accident. Multiple individuals are actively attempting to right the vehicle, and debris (including a red cloth/object) is scattered nearby. The scene shows clear evidence of a road accident with vehicle damage and post-collision response.

A black car is overturned on its side after a road accident; multiple bystanders are actively pushing and attempting to right the vehicle. Debris is scattered on the road, and the scene shows clear evidence of a recent vehicular crash (vehicle flipped, damaged, with emergency response by civilians). This matches the expected anomaly type: RoadAccidents — Vehicle COLLISION or CRASH.

A black car is overturned on its side on the road, with its trunk open and multiple people surrounding it, actively trying to lift or stabilize it. This indicates a recent road accident (vehicle flip/crash), consistent with debris on the ground and the abnormal vehicle orientation. The scene shows clear evidence of a traffic incident requiring crowd intervention.

A black car is overturned on its side on the road, with multiple people gathered around it, some attempting to lift or stabilize it. This indicates a recent road accident (vehicle flip/collision), consistent with the expected anomaly type. Debris is visible on the ground, and the scene shows urgent crowd response typical of a crash incident.

A black vehicle is overturned on its side on the road, with its rear doors open and people gathered around assisting or inspecting. Debris is scattered on the ground, and a yellow-and-black striped pole is leaning against the vehicle, suggesting a recent collision or crash. This clearly constitutes a road accident (vehicle flip/collision) as defined in the anomaly type.

A black vehicle is overturned on its side on the road, with multiple people gathered around it, some actively trying to assist or extract occupants. Debris is scattered on the ground, and the scene indicates a recent road accident (vehicle flip/collision). The presence of a fallen pole and crowd response further confirms an abnormal incident consistent with a traffic crash.
